name: choreo.stagger
meaning: The gap between one element starting and the next one starting.

name: choreo.move
meaning: How long one element takes to travel from its start to its stop.

name: choreo.fade
meaning: How long one element takes to change its color or opacity from the old value to the new one.

name: choreo.smooth
meaning: How far a followed value (a camera pan, a zoom, a fade) lags behind its target, as a time constant.
